item.title: Apple September iPhone Event: Split Launch, Price Hikes
item.description: Apple's September iPhone showcase will debut a split iPhone 18 lineup, price‑jumping Pro models, Siri‑AI devices, camera‑enabled AirPods, and more.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro Price Hike: $250‑$300 Rise Explained
item.description: Analyst Jeff Pu predicts a $250‑$300 price hike for iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max, blaming 2nm silicon and memory cost spikes, and warns of demand uncertainty.

item.title: Apple Pushes for 20% OLED Price Cut in iPhone 18 Pro Max
item.description: Apple negotiates a steep 20% OLED panel price cut for iPhone 18 Pro Max to offset rising memory costs, targeting $66.50 per panel.
